data.change_summary: Applied the only requested follow-up from review round 4 by formatting `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs`. The edit removed the stray blank line after `StartupOverrides`, so the changeset is now formatter-clean with no semantic code changes.
outstanding_risks: Legacy process field ids such as `aob_k_tan_mg` and `plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total` still encode old total-mass naming even though runtime semantics are now concentration-based.
Plant nutrient limitation still mixes water-column concentration factors with substrate-total accessibility factors; full habitat/root-zone normalization remains deferred to downstream work.
Schema-2 save migration still assumes legacy dissolved totals were stored against gross volume, so a hand-edited or previously pre-migrated schema-2 file could be rescaled again on load.
